purpose: Say that an event happens again after an earlier occurrence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Ten years later, we met again at the same station.
The rain stopped, and the sun appeared again.
The closed road became passable again.
restrictions: Often marks a renewed event after an interval.
mistake: For an immediate repetition, もう一度 may be more conversational.
